question: The tableau of which of the following states was given the title of 'Best F' in the Republic Day parade, 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is **Uttar Pradesh**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Among the **12 States/UT**s that took part in the **Republic Day** parade on January 26, 2022, the **tableau** from Uttar Pradesh has been chosen as the best tableau.
 
• The **Uttar Pradesh** tableau was built on the **concepts** of "**One District**, **One Product**, and Kashi **Vishwanath** Dham."
 
• On Republic Day 2022, **the Ministry** of **Education** won the prize for the **finest tableau**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Facts** about Uttar Pradesh:

 
 
• The **rich culture** and **traditions** of Uttar Pradesh are well-known.
 
• It is the location of the **birthplaces** of Lord **Rama**, Lord **Krishna**, and Bhagwan **Parshuram**, respectively, in** Ayodhya** and** Mathura**.
 
• Numerous domestic and **foreign travellers **visit Uttar Pradesh.
 
• It also houses the **Taj Mahal**, India's most popular tourist attraction**.**
 
• **Varanasi** is the holiest city in **Hinduism**.
 
• **One** of the **eight varieties** of Indian **classical dance, Kathak,** was developed in Uttar Pradesh.
 
• Since Uttar Pradesh is located in the **centre** of **India**, it is sometimes referred to as The **Heartland** of **India**.
